command: set -eu; R=/home/ai-core-node/frankenstein-repo; git -C "$R" fetch -q origin main; echo HEAD=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse HEAD); echo ORIGIN_MAIN=$(git -C "$R" rev-parse origin/main); echo AHEAD_BEHIND=$(git -C "$R" rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...HEAD); echo BRANCH=$(git -C "$R" branch --show-current); echo '--- status ---'; git -C "$R" status --short; echo '--- recent local ---'; git -C "$R" log --oneline --decorate -8; echo '--- files differing from origin/main ---'; git -C "$R" diff --name-status origin/main...HEAD; echo '--- latest local commit ---'; git -C "$R" show --stat --oneline --decorate --no-renames HEAD
